# Host Review Rules

- Review cancellation, stale callbacks, page/window lifecycle, offline resume,
  source switching, chapter identity and preservation of reading position.
- Check Cookie/Authorization scope, local paths, resource bounds and log redaction.
- Real SDK compilation and matching Native evidence are required for product
  compatibility; source probes do not prove device behavior.
- Preserve the L0 release boundary and all user data. No signing changes, installs,
  release publication or merges as part of a review.
